summary: Iteration 15 — Backend 6/6 PASS (admin-logout demotes & keeps session; admin user search restricted to name+mobile). Frontend BLOCKED: app red-screens on every load with ReferenceError because `adminLogout` is declared in AuthContext type/Provider value but never defined, AND `handleLongPress` is referenced in profile.tsx onLongPress but never defined. ZERO frontend flows could be exercised.

react_native_issues.issue: Line 149 Provider value uses shorthand `adminLogout` but no `adminLogout` function is declared inside AuthProvider. Runtime: ReferenceError: adminLogout is not defined → red-screen on every render. Need to add: `const adminLogout = useCallback(async () => { await api('/auth/admin-logout', { method: 'POST' }); await refreshUser(); }, [refreshUser]);`

Line 70 onLongPress={handleLongPress} but handleLongPress is never defined in the component. Need to add a handler that, when user.is_admin is true, shows Alert.alert('Logout admin?', ...) and on confirm calls adminLogout(); when not admin, opens the existing setAdminModal(true) flow.

action_items: FIX 1 (CRITICAL): Define adminLogout in /app/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.tsx. Suggested implementation: const adminLogout = useCallback(async () => { try { await api('/auth/admin-logout', { method: 'POST' }); } finally { await refreshUser(); } }, [refreshUser]);

FIX 2 (CRITICAL): Define handleLongPress in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx. Suggested: const { user, refreshUser, adminLogin, adminLogout } = useAuth(); const handleLongPress = () => { if (user?.is_admin) { Alert.alert('Logout admin?', 'You will lose admin access.', [{text:'Cancel', style:'cancel'}, {text:'Logout', style:'destructive', onPress: () => adminLogout()}]); } else { setAdminModal(true); } };

After both fixes, retest: profile long-press → Alert → Logout demotes (badge disappears, /admin becomes inaccessible); admin home stat-card taps navigate to expected routes; quizzes screen NativeAd renders on reward & limit-hit; admin/users placeholder text & search behaviour; admin/referral-settings legacy 7/15-day cards absent.
Other unrelated TS errors found by tsc (not blocking but should be cleaned): AppUser missing daily_quizzes_used, daily_surveys_used, daily_watches_used.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext exports adminLogout in its TypeScript context type and supplies it in the Provider value but never declares the local binding — this is the root cause of the global red-screen crash.
profile.tsx references undeclared identifier handleLongPress; bundle still ships because Metro/Babel does not type-check, but `tsc --noEmit` flags both errors immediately.

Profile version is currently rendered when !user?.is_admin (still visible to all non-admin users). User report wants it fully hidden — confirm intended behaviour or wrap whole versionRow conditionally on a debug flag.

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: Round 15 added `adminLogout` to AuthContextType + Provider value AND wired onLongPress={handleLongPress} on profile card, but the corresponding implementations were never written. Result: AuthProvider throws ReferenceError on first render, crashing the whole app. Reproduction: open the public preview URL → red-screen with 'adminLogout is not defined'. Confirmed via `npx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck` in /app/frontend (2 TS2304 errors). Mitigation: add the two missing function declarations as suggested above; backend endpoint is already correct and verified.
